Pokéwalker EEPROM Sprite Explorer

Drop an EEPROM .bin file here, or click to choose.
Decoder: column-major, 2bpp, 8-row pages — same as Pokéwalker firmware. Each u16 represents one column of an 8-row page. Bit 8 of the u16 is plane-1, bit 0 is plane-0 for the top row, etc. Colors map to grey shades.
